question: Which country has the lowest CO2 emissions among those shown? (A) Saudi Arabia (B) South Korea (C) Germany. Answer with just the letter.
description: MT attack on the climate bar chart. The bait bars are drawn in a highlight color and the rest in the series color, drawing the eye to the wrong bars. Our own design, nearest Lo et al. category: ineffective color scheme. True answer: B (South Korea). Bait: A (Saudi Arabia).
